subject: GROUP

roles.ULT.loc.quote: Bright Continental Limited, a company incorporated in Hong Kong and an indirect non-wholly owned subsidiary of the Company

roles.ULT.attrs.incorporated_in.quote: a company incorporated in Hong Kong and an indirect non-wholly owned subsidiary of the Company

roles.OP.loc.quote: Shanghai Yang Pu Centre Development Co., Ltd.* (上海楊浦中央社區發展有限公司), a company incorporated in the PRC with limited liability and a non-wholly owned subsidiary of the Company

roles.OP.attrs.incorporated_in.quote: a company incorporated in the PRC with limited liability and a non-wholly owned subsidiary of the Company

roles.BUYER.loc.quote: restructuring through the formation of Limited Partnership and Equity Transfer creates an opportunity to obtain an onshore acquisition loan at Limited Partnership’s level
roles.BUYER.loc.formula: the transferee is a limited partnership to be set up: it takes a domestic acquisition loan at its own level (pdf 9), its general partner is a Mainland company (pdf 4) and its limited partner, the Ningbo fund, is a Mainland limited partnership (pdf 20) — established in the Mainland; the circular does not say so expressly

holds.ULT>OP.ratio.quote: YPU is directly owned as to 86.8% by Bright Continental and 13.2% by Yangpu Knowledge Innovation.

holds.ULT>OP.since.quote: established on 26 August 2003 with a registered capital of US$30,000,000, which was jointly contributed by Shanghai Yangpu Knowledge Innovation Zone Investment and Development Co., Ltd. and Bright Continental Limited

holds.ULT>OP.cost.note: the circular only gives the registered capital contribution (US$98,952,000 after the 2024 capital reduction) and does not call it the tax cost; a foreign-currency cost is converted at the rate on the day the withholding obligation arises (公告2017年第37号), date not fixed

flows.exit.immovable_ratio.formula: appraised values: net fixed assets 607,509.60 ÷ total assets 627,221.32 (RMB ten thousand, pdf 120) = 96.86%; the fixed assets are almost entirely buildings (pdf 96: net book value RMB1,650,311,596.43)

flows.exit.listed_market_trade.formula: what is transferred is equity in a Mainland limited liability company (pdf 7), not listed shares

present.HOLD.formula: the transferor holds 86.8% of YPU directly (pdf 20), with no intermediate holding company in between

present.exit_route.quote: the 86.8% equity interests in YPU will be transferred from Bright Continental to the Limited Partnership at the consideration of approximately RMB4,706,000,000 (equivalent to approximately HK$5,159,000,000)

event.exit.quote: the 86.8% equity interests in YPU will be transferred from Bright Continental to the Limited Partnership at the consideration of approximately RMB4,706,000,000

event.on.quote: On 27 November 2024, the Equity Transfer Agreements were entered into by the relevant parties.
event.on.formula: the signing date of the equity transfer agreement is taken; the completion date is not disclosed (no later than 2025-12-31, pdf 17)

notes: Source: Shui On Land (0272.HK) circular of 2024-11-29 (cases/sources/K4-shuion-2024/source.pdf). The same circular has two transfers; this case is Bright Continental (Hong Kong) transferring 86.8% of YPU; the KIC transaction is K4-shuion-kic-2024.

The transferor is held 51% indirectly by the group (the other 49% by Wisdom Forever) and consolidated; the company did not disclose the tax withheld: "Withholding Tax" is defined as the enterprise income tax and stamp duty payable by the transferor, withheld by the limited partnership (pdf 7), and the consideration net of it is remitted to an offshore account designated by the transferor (pdf 17).
Amounts are in RMB; the consideration is the approximate figure written in the circular.

names: each party's defined term / full name in the document (aliases separated by /), individuals written as in the document, used for locating extraction patterns, search queries and registry look-ups (抽取改造.md §2, §7)
